title: Agentic SDLC, Live on Stage: Here's How the Feature Shipped
abstract: One Linear ticket, written live at Digitale Leute Summit, through every station of an agentic SDLC: ticket, context, spec and plan, build, review, hand-off. What happened between the stage and production, including the parts that didn't go cleanly.
meta-title: Agentic SDLC, Live on Stage: Here's How the Feature Shipped
meta-description: A Linear ticket written live at Digitale Leute Summit, built with an agent from spec to merge, and shipped to N+One riders. What changed and what I learned.
